observations: Photo 0 shows a large, weathered marine diesel engine on a concrete ground, surrounded by industrial equipment.
The engine has a prominent front-mounted flywheel and a large, rusted flywheel housing.
There is visible corrosion and rust on the engine block and surrounding metal parts.
The engine appears to be in a workshop or yard setting, with green machinery in the background.
No visible branding or model number is readable on the engine block or any part in the photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Detroit 671 marine engine'.

claims.evidence: No visible branding or model number in photo 0. The seller's text alone is not proof.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Engine may not be a Detroit 671 or may be damaged internally.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block showing the brand name and model number, or a video of the engine running and showing its internal components.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic used marine engine, not as a specific Detroit 671

risks.risk: Engine may have hidden mechanical damage or wear not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running, showing smooth operation and no unusual noises or vibrations.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working or with unknown condition

risks.risk: Engine may be stolen or have a compromised history.
risks.proof: Proof of origin or a certificate of ownership, or a video of the engine being tested with a valid logbook.
risks.if_unproven: priced with a discount for potential legal or ownership issues

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
Clear photo of the engine block showing the brand and model number.
Video of the engine running and showing its internal components.
Proof of origin or ownership if available.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
